study: task-trained extractive QA and ONNX dynamic INT8
decoding: Exhaustive <=30-token context spans. Question/special/pad excluded. Zero-character context tokens cannot be endpoints, may be interior and count toward length. Each window best start+end score minus its own CLS null score; highest margin across windows. Stable ties prefer lower window/start/end. Sigmoid margin is an uncalibrated ranking score, not correctness probability.
upstream_difference: This fixed within-window margin strategy is not the official Transformers global-best-span minus minimum-null aggregation.
selection_rule: For each precision choose the smallest predeclared threshold satisfying all five calibration point gates. Require BOTH variants to pass before evaluation. No best-EM fallback. Commit selection before evaluation.
failure_rule: No model, decoding, threshold-grid or score changes based on calibration/evaluation outputs. If calibration fails, stop evaluation and retain failure. If evaluation fails, keep answer entry disabled. Historical Qwen failures remain immutable.
evaluation_rule: Run each fixed variant once on the fixed evaluation partition at its own selected threshold. This is local public-benchmark assessment, not model-unseen confirmation; the upstream model already used SQuAD dev for evaluation.

compression_gate.scope: Q8-style claim is not used: this is dynamic ORT INT8. Candidate INT8 minus FP32 paired EM/F1 with fixed policy per variant, article-stratified context-family bootstrap, fixed articles.

performance.sample_rule: Eight calibration IDs with smallest sha256(seed=2026100407 + id), independent of labels and outputs
performance.timing: End-to-end per request: tokenizer, all windows ORT CPU synchronous inference, exhaustive decoding. Excludes model load, JSON evidence serialization and quality artifact verification. Report load separately. Single caller, no TTFT/decode-token claims.
performance.memory: Per-process resource.ru_maxrss with platform byte conversion; peak includes loading/session initialization/inference. Not file bytes or isolated model allocations.

scope: English supplied-passage extractive QA, <=64 question tokens, <=12000 context characters, <=8 overlapping 384-token windows. Fixed public SQuAD2 local benchmark. No training performed in this project; no proof of general business deployment, adversarial security, cross-device speedup, original quantizer, or user mastery.
